clue.text: Retreat when summer's over

definitions.meaning: to withdraw or give ground, as an army does
at the end of summer time the clocks are put back an hour

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is the phrase used for putting the clocks back at the end of British Summer Time in autumn.
explanation.definitionFit: A fall-back position is one you withdraw to, and in the US autumn is the fall, when clocks go back.

clue.text: Charge the German consumer

parts.note: a charge is a fee paid for a service
der is a German word for 'the'

explanation.surface: Someone accuses a German shopper of something.
explanation.definitionFit: A feeder is one who eats or takes in food, an eater or user.

clue.text: Strode about quietly and did the pruning

indicators.note: the word for strode goes about, around, the letter for quietly

parts.note: to lope is to stride along easily, so strode gives loped
p (piano) is the musical marking for quietly

explanation.surface: A gardener walked round softly and then cut back the shrubs.
explanation.definitionFit: To prune is to cut branches off a tree, which is just what lopping means.

clue.text: Flourishes and prospers without money

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the word for prospers sits around the money letter

parts.note: a business that prospers booms
L stands for pound, the British unit of money (from Latin libra)

explanation.surface: A business does well even with no cash behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant flourishes when it flowers, and a thriving person is said to be in full flower.

clue.text: Give a standing ovation with enthusiasm

definitions.meaning: read as two words, to cheer in full measure
gladly, in a happy and willing way

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer into its two words for the first sense: a standing ovation is applause given to the full.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing a thing gladly and in good spirits is doing it with enthusiasm; split, it means applauding wholeheartedly.

clue.text: Bound to find water underground

definitions.meaning: a natural source where groundwater rises to the surface

explanation.definitionFit: A leap is a jump forward, and a well-head where groundwater flows out is another sense of the same word.

clue.text: Agreeable requests by a social worker

parts.note: pleas are earnest requests
an ant is a social insect and a worker

explanation.surface: A friendly case worker makes a number of appeals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' is not a welfare officer but an insect living in a colony.
explanation.definitionFit: Something nice and pleasing is agreeable.

clue.text: Uncovered hair went totally awry

indicators.note: letters gone completely crooked are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone's hair has gone utterly wild and dishevelled.
explanation.definitionFit: Being naked means having nothing on, so uncovered.

clue.text: Tries to confine male abstainer in separate quarters

indicators.note: the word for tries holds the other pieces within it

parts.note: has a go, so goes
he is the male pronoun
TT means teetotal, one who abstains from alcohol

explanation.surface: Someone attempts to lock up a non-drinking man in his own rooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Ghettoes are districts where a minority group lives segregated from the rest of a city.

clue.text: 1000 PLO eyed about being in work

indicators.note: the letters are moved about, turned round into a new order

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
taken as written, the Palestine Liberation Organisation

explanation.surface: A thousand members of the Palestinian movement watched something while on duty.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a job means being in paid work.

clue.text: Calm down and pay up

definitions.meaning: to clear a bill or debt

explanation.definitionFit: Children settle when they quieten, and a debtor settles an account by paying it.

clue.text: Always on the increase

definitions.meaning: read as two words, ... means continually growing

explanation.definitionFit: Forevermore is a poetic word for forever; split, it says something keeps growing.

clue.text: Declare that a hairpiece is back to front

indicators.note: the word for the hairpiece is turned to read in the reverse order

parts.note: a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Someone states that their wig is on the wrong way round.
explanation.definitionFit: To state firmly is to declare something.

clue.text: Stand erect, despite shattering mishap

indicators.note: a mishap is an accident, wrecking the order of the word before it

explanation.surface: Someone stands up tall in spite of a devastating accident.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shattering' looks like an adjective for the mishap, but it is the anagram fodder; 'despite' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To straighten up is to rise to an upright posture.

clue.text: Recently packed as a precaution

parts.note: just means a moment ago
packed away, so stowed in a case

explanation.surface: Something was stowed in the luggage lately, so as to be safe.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something to be safe should a thing happen is acting as a safeguard.

clue.text: Use cajolery to have an active social life

definitions.meaning: to win someone over by flattery or persuasion

definitions.text: to have an active social life
definitions.meaning: to go out a lot and meet many people

explanation.definitionFit: You get round a person by coaxing them, and you get round socially by going about to many parties.

clue.text: Son gets a ticking-off for drinking too much

parts.note: a wigging is a British informal word for a scolding

explanation.surface: A boy is told off for his heavy boozing.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking big gulps of drink, especially alcohol, is excessive tippling.

clue.text: Run into Miss Davis. Now she's a dark one

indicators.note: the word run goes inside the actress's first name

parts.note: Bette Davis was the Hollywood film star

explanation.surface: Someone bumps into the actress Bette Davis, who now has dark hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman with dark brown hair is so called.

clue.text: Drawback admitted by rebel leader in humorous verse

indicators.note: the piece from drawback is let inside the scrambled letters
to rebel is to rise against order, so the letters of the next word are rearranged

parts.note: read as draw back, the word draw written backwards

explanation.surface: A disadvantage is conceded by the head of an uprising in comic poetry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drawback' is not a disadvantage but 'draw' turned back. EDWARD LEAR was the Victorian writer of nonsense verse and limericks.
explanation.definitionFit: This Victorian poet is famed for nonsense rhymes and limericks such as The Owl and the Pussycat.

clue.text: Row over Anglican service

indicators.note: in a down answer the row word sits above, over, the church letters

parts.note: a tier is a row of seats
CE stands for the Church of England

explanation.surface: A dispute breaks out about a Church of England service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like a quarrel, but it is a line of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Tierce, or terce, is one of the canonical hours of prayer, the office said at the third hour of the day.

clue.text: Witness is being examined

definitions.meaning: read as two words, ... means undergoing a test

explanation.definitionFit: To attest is to bear witness to something; split, it says one is at a test.

clue.text: An unknown make of liquor?

parts.note: a make of goods is its brand
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: Someone asks what an unfamiliar label of spirits is.
explanation.definitionFit: Brandy is a spirit distilled from wine.

clue.text: Violent band capturing a Guatemalan leader

indicators.note: the word for band holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: a ring is a band, as worn on a finger

indicators.note: the leader of the next word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A brutal gang seizes a Central American leader.
explanation.definitionFit: A raging storm or temper is fierce and wild.

clue.text: Silver-topped palanquin glowing in the light

indicators.note: the silver letters go on top, before the word for palanquin

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
a litter is a covered couch carried on poles

explanation.surface: A silver-roofed sedan chair gleams in the sunlight.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sparkling and shining is glittering.

clue.text: Auntie became a Catholic in the East

indicators.note: the letters of the word before turn into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: An aunt converted to Catholicism while living in the East.
explanation.definitionFit: Uniate churches are Eastern-rite churches in communion with Rome, keeping their own liturgy.

clue.text: Pious man served egg on fish

parts.note: ST is short for saint, a holy person
to egg someone on is to urge them
taken as written

explanation.surface: A holy man was given an egg along with his fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egg' is not food but the verb, as in egging someone on; 'served' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The sturgeon is a large fish whose roe is caviar.

clue.text: Determined to be pursued

explanation.definitionFit: A tenacious person is persistent, and someone tracked closely is followed like a hound's quarry.

clue.text: Around noon top fighter pilots attempt descent

indicators.note: the pilots' word goes around the single letter for noon

parts.note: aces are pilots with many kills
a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: At midday elite airmen try to come down.
explanation.definitionFit: Descent is one's line of family lineage, the forebears one comes from.
